title: Jmix 3 Monitoring
description: Jmix 3 metrics scraped from the /actuator/prometheus endpoint. Requires jmix.ui.ui-observation-enabled=true and jmix.core.data-observation-enabled=true.

panels.title: View open rate
panels.description: Counted by the ready stage. A layout view such as MainView gets ready on every navigation, not only when it is created

panels.title: Active sessions
panels.description: Active HTTP sessions. In a Vaadin application this is close to the number of users who work with it

panels.title: DataManager operation rate
panels.description: DataManager loads and saves per second

panels.title: Jmix error rate

targets.expr: (sum(rate({__name__=~"jmix_.+_seconds_count", application=~"$app", instance=~"$instance", error!="none", error!=""}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) * 60

panels.description: Jmix operations that ended with an exception (error tag)

panels.title: View open average time

targets.expr: sum ((sum by (lifecycle_name) (rate(jmix_ui_views_seconds_sum{application=~"$app", instance=~"$instance", lifecycle_name=~"create|load|inject|init|beforeShow|ready"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (lifecycle_name) (rate(jmix_ui_views_seconds_count{application=~"$app", instance=~"$instance", lifecycle_name=~"create|load|inject|init|beforeShow|ready"}[$__rate_interval]))) >= 0)

panels.description: Sum of the average times of the opening stages, each averaged over its own number of calls

panels.title: View close max time
panels.description: Longest closing stage (beforeClose or afterClose) in the last minutes (Timer max)

panels.title: Data loader average time
panels.description: Average load time of view data loaders

panels.title: Data loader max time
panels.description: Longest single load of a view data loader in the last minutes (Timer max)

panels.title: View open rate
panels.description: Counted by the ready stage. A layout view such as MainView gets ready on every navigation, not only when it is created

panels.title: View open average time

targets.expr: sum by (view_id) ((sum by (view_id, lifecycle_name) (rate(jmix_ui_views_seconds_sum{application=~"$app", instance=~"$instance", lifecycle_name=~"create|load|inject|init|beforeShow|ready", view_id=~"$view"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (view_id, lifecycle_name) (rate(jmix_ui_views_seconds_count{application=~"$app", instance=~"$instance", lifecycle_name=~"create|load|inject|init|beforeShow|ready", view_id=~"$view"}[$__rate_interval]))) >= 0)

panels.description: Sum of the average times of the opening stages, each averaged over its own number of calls

panels.title: View stage average time

targets.expr: (sum by (lifecycle_name) (rate(jmix_ui_views_seconds_sum{application=~"$app", instance=~"$instance", lifecycle_name=~"create|load|inject|init|beforeShow|ready", view_id=~"$view"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (lifecycle_name) (rate(jmix_ui_views_seconds_count{application=~"$app", instance=~"$instance", lifecycle_name=~"create|load|inject|init|beforeShow|ready", view_id=~"$view"}[$__rate_interval]))) >= 0

panels.description: Opening stages. The sum of the stages is the view open time

panels.title: View open max time
panels.description: Longest opening stage of each view. Timer max: the longest single operation in the last minutes. Shows rare slow operations that the average hides

panels.title: View stage max time
panels.description: Timer max: the longest single operation in the last minutes. Shows rare slow operations that the average hides

panels.title: Views with the highest open average time

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (view_id) ((sum by (view_id, lifecycle_name) (rate(jmix_ui_views_seconds_sum{application=~"$app", instance=~"$instance", lifecycle_name=~"create|load|inject|init|beforeShow|ready"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (view_id, lifecycle_name) (rate(jmix_ui_views_seconds_count{application=~"$app", instance=~"$instance", lifecycle_name=~"create|load|inject|init|beforeShow|ready"}[$__rate_interval]))) >= 0))

panels.description: Sum of the average times of the opening stages, each averaged over its own number of calls

panels.title: View close average time

targets.expr: sum by (view_id) ((sum by (view_id, lifecycle_name) (rate(jmix_ui_views_seconds_sum{application=~"$app", instance=~"$instance", lifecycle_name=~"beforeClose|afterClose", view_id=~"$view"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (view_id, lifecycle_name) (rate(jmix_ui_views_seconds_count{application=~"$app", instance=~"$instance", lifecycle_name=~"beforeClose|afterClose", view_id=~"$view"}[$__rate_interval]))) >= 0)

panels.description: Sum of the average times of the beforeClose and afterClose stages. Long closing usually means work in BeforeCloseEvent handlers, for example a check of unsaved changes

panels.title: View close max time
panels.description: Longest closing stage of each view. Timer max: the longest single operation in the last minutes. Shows rare slow operations that the average hides

targets.expr: sum by (view_id, loader_id) (rate(jmix_ui_data_seconds_sum{application=~"$app", instance=~"$instance", lifecycle_name="load", view_id=~"$view", loader_id=~"$loader"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (view_id, loader_id) (rate(jmix_ui_data_seconds_count{application=~"$app", instance=~"$instance", lifecycle_name="load", view_id=~"$view", loader_id=~"$loader"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Data loader max time

targets.expr: max by (view_id, loader_id) (jmix_ui_data_seconds_max{application=~"$app", instance=~"$instance", lifecycle_name="load", view_id=~"$view", loader_id=~"$loader"})

panels.description: Timer max: the longest single operation in the last minutes. Shows rare slow operations that the average hides

targets.expr: sum by (view_id, loader_id) (rate(jmix_ui_data_seconds_count{application=~"$app", instance=~"$instance", lifecycle_name="load", view_id=~"$view", loader_id=~"$loader"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60

panels.title: Data loaders with the highest average time

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (view_id, loader_id) (rate(jmix_ui_data_seconds_sum{application=~"$app", instance=~"$instance", lifecycle_name="load", view_id=~"$view", loader_id=~"$loader"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (view_id, loader_id) (rate(jmix_ui_data_seconds_count{application=~"$app", instance=~"$instance", lifecycle_name="load", view_id=~"$view", loader_id=~"$loader"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Data loader stage average time

targets.expr: sum by (view_id, loader_id, lifecycle_name) (rate(jmix_ui_data_seconds_sum{application=~"$app", instance=~"$instance", view_id=~"$view", loader_id=~"$loader"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (view_id, loader_id, lifecycle_name) (rate(jmix_ui_data_seconds_count{application=~"$app", instance=~"$instance", view_id=~"$view", loader_id=~"$loader"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: preLoad and postLoad are the PreLoadEvent and PostLoadEvent handlers of the application, load is the loading itself

panels.title: Data loader stage max time

targets.expr: max by (view_id, loader_id, lifecycle_name) (jmix_ui_data_seconds_max{application=~"$app", instance=~"$instance", view_id=~"$view", loader_id=~"$loader"})

panels.description: Timer max: the longest single operation in the last minutes. Shows rare slow operations that the average hides

panels.title: Fragment stage average time

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (fragment_class, lifecycle_name) (rate(jmix_ui_fragments_seconds_sum{application=~"$app", instance=~"$instance", view_id=~"$view|N/A"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (fragment_class, lifecycle_name) (rate(jmix_ui_fragments_seconds_count{application=~"$app", instance=~"$instance", view_id=~"$view|N/A"}[$__rate_interval])), "fragment", "$1", "fragment_class", ".*\\.([^.]+)")

panels.description: The ready stage has no view ID (N/A), so the View filter does not narrow it down

panels.title: Fragment stage max time
panels.description: Timer max: the longest single operation in the last minutes. Shows rare slow operations that the average hides. The ready stage has no view ID (N/A), so the View filter does not narrow it down

targets.expr: sum by (view_id, action_id) (rate(jmix_ui_actions_seconds_sum{application=~"$app", instance=~"$instance", view_id=~"$view|N/A"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (view_id, action_id) (rate(jmix_ui_actions_seconds_count{application=~"$app", instance=~"$instance", view_id=~"$view|N/A"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Action execution max time
panels.description: Timer max: the longest single operation in the last minutes. Shows rare slow operations that the average hides

panels.title: DataManager load rate
panels.description: A sharp increase in loads of one entity while the view open rate stays the same indicates loading in a loop (N+1)

targets.expr: sum by (entity_name) (rate(jmix_data_load_seconds_sum{application=~"$app", instance=~"$instance", entity_name!="", entity_name=~"$entity"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (entity_name) (rate(jmix_data_load_seconds_count{application=~"$app", instance=~"$instance", entity_name!="", entity_name=~"$entity"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: DataManager load max time
panels.description: Timer max: the longest single operation in the last minutes. Shows rare slow operations that the average hides

panels.title: DataManager save max time
panels.description: Timer max: the longest single operation in the last minutes. Shows rare slow operations that the average hides

panels.title: Database connection pool
panels.description: Pending connection requests mean that the pool is exhausted

panels.title: HTTP requests per second by outcome
GC pause time share
panels.description: Share of time the JVM spent in garbage collection pauses

panels.title: JVM threads by state
panels.description: A growing number of blocked threads indicates lock contention

panels.title: Operations in progress
panels.description: Number of operations that have started and not yet finished (long task timers). HTTP requests include the request that collects the metrics

panels.title: Longest operation in progress
panels.description: Duration of the longest operation that is still running. A growing line means that the operation hangs

panels.title: Longest DataManager load in progress by entity
panels.description: Entities whose loading is running now, by the duration of the longest load
